title: Technology Sector Update for 02/06/2018: INPX,PAR,CRUS
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Tech Stocks
MSFT +1.22%
AAPL +2.10%
IBM -0.76%
CSCO +1.43%
GOOG +0.10%
Technology stocks were firming Tuesday, with shares of tech companies in the S&P 500 adding almost 1.2% in value while the Philadelphia semiconductor index was riding a more than 2.1% gain.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
- Inpixon ( INPX ) plunged over 35% on Tuesday, sinking to a session low of $5.05 a share after the "big data" analytics company completed a 30-for-1 reverse split of its common stock just before the market open. Shareholders approved the move on Feb. 2.
In other sector news:
+ PAR Technology ( PAR ) was moving between small gains and losses Tuesday after saying its PAR Government Systems subsidiary won a $4.5 million research and development contract from the US Air Force. The three-year contract calls on the company to develop systems for command, control, communications, computer, intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance across cyber, air and space domains.
- Cirrus Logic ( CRUS ) was down over 4% in afternoon trading following a downgrade of the specialty chipmaker to Hold from Buy today at Needham & Co.
